task.payload: {"metadata":{"description":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 GitHub 连接器：一键授权，对话内创建/AI 审查/合并 PR | GitHub connector for dsh: one-click connect, create/review/merge PRs from the conversation","id":"gh:1333306158","install_available":false,"language":"TypeScript","name":"dsh-github-connector","slug":"kaziii/dsh-github-connector","topics":["agent","connector","deepseek","dsh","dsh-plugin","dsh-plugins","github","plugin"]},"paragraphs":[{"id":"p1s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 GitHub 连接器：一键授权，对话内创建/AI 审查/合并 PR | GitHub connector for dsh: one-click con"},{"id":"p1s2","text":"nect, create/review/merge PRs from the conversation"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-github-connector"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**简体中文** | English"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的 GitHub 连接器插件 —— 一键连接 GitHub 账号，不离开 dsh 对话即可创建 PR、AI 审查 PR、合并 PR。"},{"id":"p5s1","text":"- **一键连接** —— 在 dsh 设置页走 GitHub Device Flow 授权，无需复制粘贴 token。\n- **输入框上方的 PR 状态条** —— 创建 PR / AI 审查 / "},{"id":"p5s2","text":"合并，由 git 状态触发。\n- **模型侧工具** —— `github_search`、`github_issue_read`、`github_pr_read`、`github_issue_cre"},{"id":"p5s3","text":"ate`、`github_issue_comment`、`github_pr_create`。"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"检测到当前分支领先默认分支时，输入框上方会出现 PR 状态条，一键创建 PR："},{"id":"p7s1","text":"文档：索引 · 架构 · ADR"},{"id":"p8s1","text":"## 安装"},{"id":"p9s1","text":"前置条件：Node ≥ 22.19、pnpm、dsh CLI（`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`）。"},{"id":"p10s1","text":"从 npm 一条命令安装："},{"id":"p11s1","text":"[代码示例省略，未执行]"},{"id":"p12s1","text":"（把 `web` 换成你的 profile 名 —— `headless`、`tui` 等。`dsh-ui-github` 只在 web 客户端渲染，非 web profile 可不装。）"},{"id":"p13s1","text":"## 连接 GitHub 账号"},{"id":"p14s1","text":"打开 **dsh 设置 → 插件**，点击 **连接 GitHub** 按钮，按提示完成 Device Flow 授权 —— token 只保存在宿主，不落入任何配置文件："},{"id":"p15s1","text":"CLI / headless 场景则设置 `GITHUB_TOKEN` 环境变量（带 `repo` 权限的 personal access token）。"},{"id":"p16s1","text":"## 许可证"},{"id":"p17s1","text":"MIT"}],"truncated":false}
